name: Itty Bitty Kitty NY (IBKNY)

notes: Small all-volunteer Bay Ridge community-cat rescue (NOT a 501(c)(3); donations not tax-deductible). TNR + friendly rescue/adoption; adopts kittens in pairs. Lost donated holding space in 2020 (foster-based since). Site live and adopting as of 2026 re-check; co-founder George Politis (featured in 'The Cat Rescuers') long the primary caretaker - confirm current capacity via application/IG. Re-verified 2026-08-26. Intake: Adoption/foster application on site Intake: urgent-request page
